sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark 1.1
sources.evidence: Dated July 9, 2026. Announces the exact 1.1 model, public API preview and Thinking mode in Meta AI; describes coding, computer use and multi-agent workflows.

sources.title: Models - Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Current documentation explicitly includes muse-spark-1.1 among three Spark versions with 1,048,576-token context, text/image/video/audio/PDF inputs and text output. Lists 1.1 as Standard-mode API access only, separate from Spark Open.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.1 Evaluation Report
sources.evidence: The 112-page report identifies Meta Superintelligence Labs and the Muse Spark family, distinguishes 1.1 from 1.0, and documents developer-controlled tool/function calling. No total/active parameter count or production architecture specification appears.

sources.title: Meta Model API Terms of Service
sources.evidence: October 9, 2026 terms reserve ownership of Services to Meta/licensors and restrict extracting weights or deriving proprietary components. API access is governed by these terms separately from any open-weight license.

sources.title: Meta Model API Model Designation and Geographic Use Policy
sources.evidence: October 12, 2026 policy explicitly designates Muse Spark 1.1 a Standard Model under the API Terms; Contributor designations apply to 1.2 and 1.3 variants.

sources.title: Reasoning - Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Spark models generate internal reasoning tokens before output. Reasoning effort is configurable; max is specifically limited to newer supported models, so it is not inferred for 1.1.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.2 & Muse Code Evaluation Methodology
sources.evidence: Exact 1.1 is an evaluation comparator, with xhigh reasoning effort. The report does not disclose its size or architecture.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.3 Evaluation Report
sources.evidence: Later 140-page report includes exact 1.1 comparisons but no parameter count or architectural specification for it. Model interview statements are not engineering disclosures.

sources.title: Muse Wonder Model Card
sources.evidence: Later 13-page first-party comparison card provides evaluations, not an exact Muse Spark 1.1 parameter/architecture disclosure.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open Model Card
sources.evidence: The overview assigns 816B total, 42B active and MoE Transformer with perception encoder specifically to Muse Spark Open, released October 15. Its comparison table does not assign these specifications to 1.1.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
sources.evidence: Meta training report revised October 23 describes Glimmer architecture and distillation from a teacher named Muse Spark; it does not establish exact 1.1 counts or architecture. Glimmer specifications cannot be transferred.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.1 - Meta developer model page
sources.evidence: Exact-model page confirms name, native multimodal perception, computer use and multi-agent workflows. Its US-preview wording is a launch-era description, whereas current docs and policy govern documented availability.

developer.note: Developed by Meta Superintelligence Labs; Meta is the catalog developer.

family.note: Muse Spark family; muse retains the existing normalized umbrella key.

release_date.note: Public 1.1 launch and API preview on July 9. April 8 was the original Spark release; later provider or regional availability is not this release date.

open_weights.note: 1.1 is the hosted Standard API model. The downloadable Spark Open release has its own name and license; it does not establish a 1.1 weight release.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the exact API model, governed by Meta Model API Terms; not the separate Muse Model License for Spark Open.

parameters_b.note: No exact 1.1 total disclosed in the reviewed launch/report and later comparison/training sources. Spark Open 816B is not transferable.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact 1.1 active count disclosed. Neither equality with total nor Spark Open 42B is inferred.

architecture.note: No exact 1.1 production architecture established by reviewed reports or targeted first-party training/interpretability searches. Open MoE and Glimmer dense Transformer details describe other models.

context_window.note: Current documentation explicitly applies this token limit to all three listed Spark versions, including 1.1.

modalities.note: Add documented audio input; PDFs remain a supported input format. Modalities reflect current documented API capability, not only launch examples.

reasoning.note: Dedicated Thinking mode is explicit; later methodology uses xhigh for exact 1.1. This is more than an inference from task performance.

tool_call.note: The exact 1.1 API exposes developer-controlled tool and function calling.

description.value: Meta's proprietary multimodal reasoning model for coding and agentic tasks, with tool and function calling, computer use, and multi-agent orchestration.
description.note: Use exact 1.1 capabilities and remove the inherited generic visual-chain-of-thought phrasing.

patch.notes: Muse Spark 1.1 launched July 9, 2026 with Meta Model API public preview and Thinking mode in Meta AI. Current documentation lists Standard API availability; endpoint operation was not tested. Total and active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed for this exact version. Muse Spark Open is a separate open-weight release; its 816B/42B MoE specifications do not establish 1.1 specifications.

summary: Correct release date from original Spark April 8 launch to exact 1.1 July 9 launch, classify API license as proprietary, add documented audio input and use a version-specific description. Confirm 1,048,576-token context, reasoning and native tool/function calling. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed after exact-model and later first-party report/card checks; no sibling specifications transferred.
